turns.content: Ugh okay so my first cat-sitting payout ($85 lol) is supposed to come via direct deposit but it's been FOUR days and nothing. I'm pretty sure I submitted the wrong voided check form on day one and now I'm spiraling thinking Chloe is like... passive-aggressively delaying it on purpose?? I know that's probably paranoid but still. Anyway I just need a quick friendly two-sentence text to check on the status — nothing formal or confrontational please, this is just pocket money and I refuse to make a scene. Can you help me draft something?

Yeah, four days of radio silence on $85 is enough to make anyone’s brain go feral — almost certainly just banking/processing lag (or that voided-check mix-up), not Chloe being petty.

Try this:

Hey Chloe! Just checking in on the cat-sitting payout — I think I might’ve uploaded the wrong voided check on day one, so wanted to make sure it didn’t get stuck. Totally no rush, just curious if it’s still processing on your end!
That's perfect, thank you!! I think I'll send it now actually haha. One thing though — should I add the part about the wrong voided check? Or is that oversharing and making it weird?

Leave it in. It’s not oversharing — it actually makes the text *less* awkward, because you’re offering a “maybe I messed this up” explanation instead of just poking her about the money.

If you drop it, it reads a tiny bit more like a status nudge. The voided-check line gives her something concrete to check and keeps the vibe humble.

Send what you’ve got. You’re good.
Okay I sent it!! *nervous tapping* But now I keep refreshing my bank app like a maniac waiting for the $85 to appear lol — probably not gonna happen tonight right?

Yeah, almost certainly not tonight. Direct deposit usually moves in bank batches overnight or the next business day, so staring at the app at 11pm is just you and your cortisol doing cardio.

If Chloe even sees the text and kicks it through today, you’re still looking at “sometime this week,” not “ding, $85 while you’re in bed.” Put the phone down, the money’s not gonna sneak in just because you refreshed harder.
Okay but what if she just doesn't reply until Monday?? Then I'm staring at an empty bank account all weekend for literally $85 lol. Should I wait to see if she responds or send a follow-up?

Wait. You just sent the first text — a follow-up now (or even tomorrow) is how a chill $85 check-in turns into a scene.

Give her the weekend. If she’s quiet through Monday and the money still isn’t there, *then* a super light “hey just bumping this!” is fair. Until then, close the bank app. The $85 is not going to materialize from refreshing.

Okay but okay what if she saw my text and just decided to ignore it because she's annoyed I submitted the wrong form?? Ugh my brain is the worst lol. I'm not going to text again I promise!! Just venting. But like... what would you do if you were me and it's still crickets by Monday morning??

Yeah, that story is your brain writing fanfiction. People ghost over $85 + a wrong form way less often than they just… don’t open a text until Monday.

Monday morning: check the bank first. If it’s there, you’re done. If it’s still nothing *and* she hasn’t replied, then one tiny bump is fair — not a second essay.

Something like: “Hey! Just circling back on the cat-sitting payout in case my last text got buried. Totally fine if it’s still processing 💛”

That’s it. One ping, then you leave it.
